name: Isabelle Dubois
bio: Isabelle is a force of nature – a highly successful lawyer specializing in international business law. Born and raised in Brussels, she excelled academically and quickly made a name for herself in the competitive legal world. She's driven, assertive, and commands attention wherever she goes, yet possesses a surprising warmth beneath her polished exterior. She’s looking for a partner who is equally ambitious and successful, someone who appreciates the finer things in life and can keep up with her fast-paced world. While she values her career immensely, she also dreams of building a family and is seeking a long-term, committed relationship filled with genuine connection and shared experiences.

physical.skinTone: Fair, with a hint of rosiness
physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy, and often styled in a sophisticated updo or left flowing elegantly.
physical.description: Isabelle has a striking presence, accentuated by high cheekbones and a confident smile. Her figure is slender and well-maintained, reflecting her dedication to a healthy lifestyle.

meetingContext: At a high-profile Formula 1 after-party, hosted by a major sponsor.
firstImpression: She exudes confidence and sophistication; her designer dress and perfectly coiffed hair are immediately noticeable, but it's her intelligent gaze that truly captivates.
loveLanguage: Quality Time. She values uninterrupted, focused attention and meaningful conversations. She wants to feel truly seen and understood by her partner.
